plan.notes: Official Rio Hondo College Guided Pathways sample education plan (pathways.riohondo.edu), 2026-2027 catalog year. The page's main sample plan is used (Cal-GETC pattern); the alternate map in the page's dropdown is not modeled. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total 62.5 units = sum of published pathway slots. Fixed courses list only Advisories or placement-based requirements in their published descriptions (PSY 190: placement via HS GPA/other measures or a pre-statistics/intermediate algebra course; ENGL C1000/STAT C1000: placement) — not modeled as course prereqs since no plan course satisfies them. CD 228 (4th semester) carries a real official prerequisite — CD 106, CD 110, CD 111, CD 114 and CD 208 (CD 106 is the former number of CDEV C1000) — all satisfied by plan courses; noted on the slot. Choice slots model the official 'Select One' requirements; see choice notes. Dagger (†): some GE choice classes may carry higher units; slots encoded at published values.

courses.title: Principles and Practices of Early Childhood Education
Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences or Introduction to Statistics
courses.choice_note: Cal-GETC 2. Official map lists PSY 190 / STAT C1000 / STAT C1000H; the map's note adds that DSCI 101, MATH 150, MATH 160, MATH 170, MATH 180, MATH 190/190H, or STAT C1000H may also fulfill this requirement. PSY 190 official prerequisite: enrollment requires appropriate placement (based on high school GPA and/or other measures), or completion of a pre-statistics or an intermediate algebra course (not a plan course). STAT C1000 official prerequisite: placement or completion of a course at or above elementary algebra (not a plan course).
